changelog:
- Release 0.18.0: Skin variables per component, Health check and terminal commands on the Deploy tab, smaller hero title, whole company logo, Business/Services wording, clean heading outline, Cloudflare purge after a build
- Deploy tab: fix the health-check address, wrap long commands
- Deploy tab: Health check (GitHub access, last request, build folder, flagged pages, live page) and Check it yourself (copy-ready terminal commands for this site)
- CI: the rsync build clears the Cloudflare cache after the files are in place (optional: needs CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN and CLOUDFLARE_ZONE_ID in the Environment)
- Skin variables grouped per component (buttons, chips, callouts, tables, header/footer, hero); smaller default hero title; whole logo in the company card; Business/Services wording; clean heading outline
- CI: deploy.yml deploys only widev.pro (rsync-only key); drop the dayo-staging and Blyss jobs of other projects. Docs: the GitHub token needs Contents: Read and write
- CI: rsync to the widev.pro server now sets group-writable permissions (-p with --chmod), so WordPress's own updater can replace the plugin folder without leaving it half-removed
